name: Crimson Rafflesia
source:
During the late 20th century, a series of strange deaths occurred. All of the victims were found with their bodies putrefied, even though they were seen only a few hours ago. The deaths stopped as quickly as they had come, only to be replaced with a series of strange disappearances.

The government tried to hush it up, because they had no leads – but to no avail. The powerful Wilshire Corporation continued to keep tabs on the case, while at the same time a private detective group went on a manhunt for the perpetrator. These cases closed upon the unfortunate deaths of said group in an accident. Years passed, and all was well.

All was well, until the decaying corpse of Mikaela Lane turned up at the back of an abandoned church.

This story is set a year after that – about a young female corporate mercenary, Sho Reilen, who is skilled in the use of swords. She has something she wants – to confront Kaison Voltaire, a young man who seeks to hunt her down in revenge for the death of his beloved friend, Mikaela.

Crimson Rafflesia is a story about truth and lies, love and hate, and a field of decaying flowers.

[From [url=http://soyasushi.vnovel.com/works-in-progress-2/crimson-rafflesia]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
20 世纪末，发生了一系列离奇死亡事件。所有受害者被发现时尸体都已腐烂，尽管他们几小时前才刚被人见过。这些死亡事件来得快，停得也快，随后取而代之的是一连串诡异失踪案。

政府试图压下此事，因为他们毫无线索，但最终徒劳无功。强大的威尔希尔公司继续关注着案件，同时一支私家侦探团队也展开了追捕凶手的行动。最终，这些案件因该团队不幸死于事故而不了了之。多年过去，一切似乎都很平静。

直到米凯拉·莱恩腐烂的尸体出现在一座废弃教堂的后方。

故事发生在那之后一年，讲述年轻的企业佣兵肖·莱伦。她精通剑术，有一件必须完成的事——面对凯森·伏尔泰。这个年轻人为了替心爱的朋友米凯拉报仇，正试图追杀她。

《Crimson Rafflesia》讲述真相与谎言、爱与恨，以及一片腐烂花田的故事。
